T: The summer we went looking for dinner.
D: Four boys set off on a hike to find a dead body.
P: Serve dessert when Gordie tells the pie-eating contest story at the campfire.
S: the night in the woods on the hike
Big marshmallows toasted on sticks over the fire until blistered, dipped in melted dark chocolate and pressed between digestive biscuits.
Milo Pressman's junkyard and his dog
Ham and cheddar on buttered white bread with mustard and a few pickles, wrapped tight in wax paper for the walk.
the campfire debate over the one food you'd eat forever

Soft cherry gummies made with real cherry juice and gelatine, rolled in sour sugar, the kind of lolly the boys argue about by the fire. Heat 250ml cherry juice with 80g caster sugar until dissolved. Sprinkle 30g powdered gelatine over 100ml cold cherry juice, leave 5 minutes, then stir into the hot juice until clear. Add 1 tbsp lemon juice and pour into a lightly oiled 20cm square tin. Chill 3 hours until firm. Cut into squares and roll in 50g caster sugar mixed with 1 tsp citric acid.
M: camping out by the tracks for the night

Smoky franks charred in a hot skillet, tucked into soft buns with sticky onion relish, mustard and crunchy pickles. Slice 3 onions thinly and cook in 30g butter over low heat for 25 minutes until jammy, then add 1 tbsp brown sugar and 2 tbsp cider vinegar and cook 2 minutes more. Score 8 franks and cook in a hot cast iron pan for 6 minutes, turning, until blistered. Warm 8 hot dog buns in the pan. Fill each bun with a frank, a spoon of onion relish, mustard and sliced pickles.
the ground beef Gordie buys at the general store
Beef mince seasoned with salt and pepper, shaped into thick patties, cooked over coals or a hot pan, eaten in bread with fried onions.
W: the pie-eating contest, minus the ending
Blueberries with sugar, lemon and cornflour in a lattice-topped pie, baked at 190C for 50 minutes, cooled before slicing.
K: the general store before the long walk

Ice-cold sarsaparilla poured slowly over vanilla ice cream in chilled glasses so it foams to the top, with a long spoon and a straw. Chill 4 tall glasses in the freezer for 15 minutes. Put 2 scoops vanilla ice cream in each glass. Pour 300ml cold sarsaparilla slowly down the side of each glass, letting the foam settle before topping up. Serve straight away with a straw and a long spoon.

s.note: the night in the woods on the hike
s.how: Toast 16 big marshmallows on sticks over the fire or a gas flame until blistered. Dip in 100g melted dark chocolate and squash between 2 digestive biscuits, 32 biscuits in all. Eat while still gooey.

s.note: Milo Pressman's junkyard and his dog
s.how: Butter 8 slices white bread and spread with mustard. Fill with 200g ham, 100g sliced cheddar and a few pickles. Cut in half and wrap each tightly in wax paper, ready for the walk.

m.note: the ground beef Gordie buys at the general store
m.how: Season 800g beef mince with salt and pepper and shape into 4 thick patties. Cook over hot coals or in a smoking pan for 5 minutes a side. Fry 2 sliced onions alongside until soft and sweet. Serve the patties between thick slices of white bread with the onions and tomato sauce.

w.note: the pie-eating contest, minus the ending
w.how: Toss 750g blueberries with 150g sugar, the juice of a lemon and 3 tbsp cornflour. Line a pie dish with 2 sheets sweet shortcrust, fill and weave a lattice from 2 more. Bake at 190C for 50 minutes and cool 3 hours.

d.note: the general store before the long walk
d.how: Chill 4 tall glasses in the freezer for 15 minutes. Put 2 scoops vanilla ice cream in each glass. Pour 300ml cold sarsaparilla slowly down the side of each glass, letting the foam settle before topping up. Serve straight away with a straw and a long spoon.
